pkgmetadata.longdescription: Euro-Office Desktop Editors is a European fork of the ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors: a word processor, spreadsheet, presentation and PDF editor with native OOXML (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) support, plus ODF, RTF, EPUB and more. This is the upstream prebuilt amd64 .deb release, installed under /opt/euro-office; it can be installed alongside app-office/onlyoffice-bin. Upstream stopped shipping the offline help in 9.3.8, so no separate help package is needed.
